incidents.failure: Work initially followed the older Family-J/WIP context while Research main had already advanced to later registries and RQ-020E/RQ-021 state.
incidents.prevention: Canonical-head lock: fetch main SHA, manifest and registry from that SHA; compare branch base and open WIP before any analysis or write.
incidents.root_cause: No mandatory latest-main/manifest/registry lock was completed before continuing prior context.
incidents.time_waste: The repository had to be reoriented, the current registry rediscovered and the obsolete path abandoned before useful work resumed.

incidents.failure: The first RQ-020E Stage-2 evaluator imported the fixed-five portability signal library, which did not implement the full twelve-family R1 universe, and stopped with ValueError: impulse_breakout.
incidents.prevention: Capability-matrix preflight must assert every requested family/function before data loading; subset libraries cannot serve a full-universe run without an explicit complete mapping.
incidents.root_cause: The evaluator import graph was not checked against the complete declared family/function capability set.
incidents.time_waste: Evaluator selection, execution and repair were repeated.

incidents.failure: A long single-file HYP-023 evaluator transfer had a truncation/encoding integrity risk and was abandoned before outcomes.
incidents.prevention: Split large evaluator source before transfer; verify local SHA-256, Git blob SHA, byte count, line count, syntax and imports for every fetched-back module.
incidents.root_cause: A large multi-responsibility source file was transferred through connector payloads before establishing a module-size and fetch-back integrity rule.
incidents.time_waste: The evaluator had to be split into data, simulation and evaluation modules, rewritten and fetched back for identity verification.

incidents.failure: The first authorized HYP-023 exact outcome invocation used an incorrect local preregistration path and stopped before data loading, signal generation or P/L.
incidents.prevention: Command/path manifest must verify working directory, protocol path, evaluator path, input paths and SHAs before importing data.
incidents.root_cause: The execution command was assembled ad hoc rather than generated from a committed run manifest with path and SHA assertions.
incidents.time_waste: The command had to be corrected and rerun.

incidents.failure: The HYP-023 evaluator did not directly produce every preregistered output, notably realized drawdown and parameter-equivalence summaries, so a post-result summarizer was required.
incidents.prevention: Outcome authorization is blocked unless every required output has a declared file/schema producer and the preflight verifies the full output manifest.
incidents.root_cause: Preflight checked evaluator execution but did not machine-compare protocol required_outputs with the evaluator output manifest.
incidents.time_waste: A second code path and output audit were needed after the binding run.

incidents.failure: Notion Current State properties were updated to registry v40/HYP-023 while the body still contained registry v39/RQ-022 text and older authorization boundaries.
incidents.prevention: Notion synchronization must compare both properties and body: main commit, registry, question/hypothesis, active family, next action, canonical pointers and locks.
incidents.root_cause: Synchronization checked database properties but not body pointers and authorization text as one contract.
incidents.time_waste: Repeated Notion updates and readbacks were required and the page remained internally inconsistent during the stage.

new_mandatory_controls: canonical-head lock before branch or analysis
full-family capability matrix before evaluator import

scientific_result_classification.reason: The frozen six-cell family executed and failed its preregistered scientific gates; this is valid evidence, not an operational malfunction.

scope: Recovery from stale work state through RQ-020E/RQ-021/RQ-022 and the first exact HYP-023 research evaluation

time_accounting.avoidable_overhead_assessment: material, plausibly tens of minutes, but not measured precisely
time_accounting.interpretation: The 57m30s interval contains legitimate analysis and packaging as well as avoidable overhead; it cannot be assigned wholly to failures.
largest_avoidable_sources: starting from stale branch/context before resolving current main
sequential connector writes and source-transfer repair
rerunning after an ad hoc local path error
post-result completion of outputs that should have been enforced by preflight
partial Notion synchronization and repeated readback
time_accounting.reason: Per-stage start/finish, connector time, local compute time and retry time were not logged independently.
